Counsel for Applicant :- Om Prakash Rai,Ashish Rai Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Om Prakash Rai, learned counsel for the applicant, Dr. S. B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State-respondent and Ms. Tabassum Hashmi, learned counsel for the informant.

2. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No.1055 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC, Police Station Kavi Nagar,
District Ghaziabad, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text:
3. FIR of the present case was lodged on 19.11.2023 against applicant and others and according to the FIR, on the basis of forged will of his father applicant tried to get transfer of the shares of S.R.F.
Limited Company in his name and he also after making forged death certificate of his brother i.e.
informant of the case and tried to get share of the companies.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on the basis of false allegation applicant has been made accused in the present matter and after the death of the father of the applicant, a dispute with regard to property is pending between applicant and informant and informant also filed a suit for Ashok Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another

5. He further submits that even prima-facie present dispute appears to be of civil nature and if as per informant, the will of the father of the applicant was forged then he can knocked the door of the competent civil court.
6. He further submits that applicant has neither prepared any forged will of his father nor he ever prepared the forged death certificate of the informant and even as per the allegation on the basis of forged death certificate, he tried to grab the shares of the company of his father and therefore, even as per the allegation applicant only made attempt to grab the shares of the company.
7.
He further submits that present dispute is not of such a nature in which arrest of the applicant is required.

8. He further submits that however apart from the present case, applicant is having criminal history of two other cases but both these cases were also lodged by the informant of the case and in one case relates to Section 308 I.P.C. applicant has already been acquitted by the trial court and appeal filed by the informant is still pending before this Court and another case relates to Case Crime No.85 of 2023 is pending before the court concerned.
9. He further submits that investigation of the case is pending and police is trying to arrest the applicant.
10. Per contra, learned A.G.A-I. as well as

learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail and submit that applicant is the brother of the informant and he is continuously trying to grab the shares of the company on the basis of forged documents which were in the name of their late father.

11. They further submit that applicant is continuously grabbing the property of his father, therefore,
considering the nature of allegation and conduct of the applicant, he should not be released on anticipatory bail.
12. I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

13. As per the FIR, on the basis of forged will of his father and forged death certificate of the informant, applicant is trying to grab the shares of the company, which were in the name of their late father but admittedly the alleged shares were not transferred in his name, therefore, it was an attempt on behalf of the applicant to grab the shares of the company after the death of his father.

14. Further, a dispute with regard to the will cannot be decided by this Court at this stage and it appears that no civil suit with regard to the alleged will of the father of the applicant is pending before the competent civil court.
However, it reflects from the record that a civil suit for permanent injunction filed by the informant against the applicant is pending.

sentences.text: Further, however apart from the present case, applicant is having criminal history of two other cases and both these cases were also lodged by the informant of the case and in one case relates to Section 308
I.P.C. applicant has already been acquitted by the trial court and in another case, trial of the case is pending.

16. Further, I find force in the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that in the present matter arrest of the applicant does not appear to be necessary and apprehension of arrest raised by him cannot be ruled out.
17. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail till conclusion of trial.
18. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant anticipatory bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

21. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
